Take out the thin white dart trails and their small arrow heads completely: the cursor is not firing now. The round orange bullets may stay.

The moment: the cursor was beaten down, and it has just turned back to fight one more round. The ceramic under the cursor is pressed into a shallow round crater with fine cracks running out of it. Small chips of ceramic and a few shards of green glass have lifted off the ground and hang in the air round the cursor. The gold light lies warm on the ground, on the pillars and on the glass, and everything near throws its shadow straight away from the cursor.
